_comment: Scoring constants. Source: data/site/rules.txt and data/site/faq.txt,
read live from fantasysurvivorgame.com/rules.html and /faq.html on 2026-09-17.
confidence: high = quoted verbatim from the site. low = not on the site; a guess.
The code reads every number here at run time. Nothing is hard-coded in fsb/.

vote.points_awarded: points assigned to the castaway who is voted out
vote.deadline: before the episode airs on the US East coast
counts_as_voted_out: most votes and sent somewhere else, e.g. Extinction Island
vote.double_boot_or_split_tribal: not addressed on the rules page. Each castaway voted out that night is presumably scored the same way, since the rule is per-castaway, not per-episode. Unconfirmed - question 5, still open.
vote.tribe_swap_budget: the rule reads '10 points per tribe, each week'. If a swap creates a third tribe, the budget scales to 10 x (tribe count) that week. This is a direct reading of the rule text, not a separate confirmation - question 6, still open.

resolution: rules.html says a castaway who leaves keeps earning 1 point per episode,
including the episode they leave (0-13). faq.html says a drafted survivor
'will stop earning you points'. The standings page settles it: it has an
'Out' column titled 'Extra points gained for Survivors voted out', and its
markup comments 'Extra points earned by both survivors being out of game'

outplay.roster_size_confidence: high - howto-draft.html: 'Each player will draft 2 Survivors', and the standings markup says 'both survivors'. CORRECTED 2026-09-18: an earlier version of this file said 3, inferred from the three empty drop-slots on draft.html; js/draft-helper.js shows those are UI placeholders ('a maximum of 3 and a minimum of 1'), not roster slots.
outplay.roster_mechanic: exclusive snake draft over two rounds, draft order random, run automatically at the draft time (howto-draft.html). You submit a preference order over all 21 castaways; at each of your turns the site takes the highest-ranked castaway still available. Ranking by your own value is optimal here: you cannot influence what others take, and values add.
outplay.roster_editable_confidence: still unknown - the preference order can clearly be resubmitted before draft time (tools/submit.py verified this), but whether the 3 actually-drafted castaways can be swapped out after Sep 23 8:00 PM EDT is unconfirmed. Question 2, still open until after the draft.

episode, that the correct winner was the standing pick. Switching away
